ko.title: 추수감사절 식탁의 경제학: 올해 칠면조, 스터핑, 파이 가격은 얼마일까

segments.src: Every November, the Thanksgiving shopping list doubles as a small economic report.
segments.tr: 매년 11월이면 추수감사절 쇼핑 목록은 일종의 소규모 경제 보고서 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: Turkey, stuffing, potatoes, cranberries and pie ingredients all land in the same cart, and the total tells families a lot about how far their budgets stretch.
segments.tr: 칠면조, 스터핑, 감자, 크랜베리, 파이 재료가 모두 같은 카트에 담기며, 그 총액은 가족들에게 예산이 얼마나 여유가 있는지 알려줍니다.

segments.src: This year, three forces are shaping that total: persistent grocery inflation, trade policy that affects some imported ingredients, and an uneven poultry supply.
segments.tr: 올해는 지속적인 식료품 물가 상승, 일부 수입 재료에 영향을 미치는 무역 정책, 그리고 불균형한 가금류 공급이라는 세 가지 요인이 그 총액을 결정짓고 있습니다.

segments.src: This article is a general guide, not a price forecast.
segments.tr: 이 기사는 일반적인 가이드일 뿐, 가격 예측 자료가 아닙니다.

segments.src: Prices vary by region, store and week, so treat the trends below as a framework for planning rather than exact figures.
segments.tr: 가격은 지역, 매장, 주 단위로 달라지므로 아래의 추세는 정확한 수치가 아닌 계획을 위한 참고 자료로 활용하시기 바랍니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Bill Looks Different in 2026
segments.tr: ## 2026년 식비가 다르게 느껴지는 이유

segments.src: ### Grocery prices remain elevated
segments.tr: ### 식료품 가격은 여전히 높은 수준

segments.src: Food prices have cooled from their peak rate of increase, but cooling inflation is not the same as falling prices.
segments.tr: 식품 가격 상승률은 정점을 찍고 둔화되었지만, 물가 상승세가 둔화되었다고 해서 가격이 하락한 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Many staples cost noticeably more than they did a few years ago, and shoppers still feel that gap at the register.
segments.tr: 많은 필수품 가격이 몇 년 전보다 눈에 띄게 올랐으며, 쇼핑객들은 계산대에서 여전히 그 차이를 체감하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Labor, transportation and packaging costs continue to feed into shelf prices, even when ingredient costs ease.
segments.tr: 재료비가 안정되더라도 인건비, 운송비, 포장비가 계속해서 매장 판매 가격에 반영되고 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ### Tariffs and imported ingredients
segments.tr: ### 관세와 수입 재료

segments.src: Some Thanksgiving ingredients rely wholly or partly on imports.
segments.tr: 일부 추수감사절 재료는 전체 또는 일부를 수입에 의존합니다.

segments.src: Spices such as cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves, certain canned and packaged goods, and some specialty items can be affected when trade policy changes.
segments.tr: 계피, 육두구, 정향과 같은 향신료, 특정 통조림 및 가공식품, 일부 특수 품목은 무역 정책이 변경될 때 영향을 받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Because tariffs are paid by importers, the extra cost may be absorbed, shared or passed on to shoppers, and the effect differs from product to product.
segments.tr: 관세는 수입업자가 부담하기 때문에 추가 비용은 흡수되거나 분담되거나 소비자에게 전가될 수 있으며, 그 영향은 제품마다 다릅니다.

segments.src: Expect the biggest impact on items with few domestic substitutes.
segments.tr: 국내 대체재가 거의 없는 품목에서 가장 큰 영향이 나타날 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: Staples grown mostly in the United States, such as potatoes, cranberries and pumpkin, are generally less exposed.
segments.tr: 감자, 크랜베리, 호박처럼 미국에서 주로 재배되는 필수품은 일반적으로 영향이 덜합니다.

segments.src: ### Shifting poultry supplies
segments.tr: ### 가금류 공급의 변화

segments.src: Turkey is the centerpiece, and its price depends on flock health and production decisions made months earlier.
segments.tr: 칠면조는 추수감사절 식탁의 중심이며, 그 가격은 가축의 건강 상태와 몇 달 전에 내려진 생산 결정에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: Outbreaks of avian disease in recent years have disrupted bird supplies at various points, and producers have been cautious about rebuilding.
segments.tr: 최근 몇 년간 발생한 조류 질병 발병으로 인해 여러 시점에서 가금류 공급에 차질이 빚어졌고, 생산자들은 공급량 회복에 신중을 기해 왔습니다.

segments.src: When supply is tight, whole frozen birds can be less available or more expensive, and retailers often respond with promotions to draw shoppers into stores.
segments.tr: 공급이 부족하면 냉동 통칠면조를 구하기 어렵거나 가격이 비싸질 수 있으며, 소매업체들은 고객을 매장으로 유인하기 위해 종종 할인 행사를 진행합니다.

segments.src: Watching weekly store flyers usually matters more than any national average.
segments.tr: 전국 평균 가격보다는 매주 발행되는 매장 전단지를 확인하는 것이 보통 더 중요합니다.

segments.src: ## Which Items Deserve a Closer Look
segments.tr: ## 더 자세히 살펴봐야 할 품목

segments.src: - **Turkey:** The biggest single line item for many households. Prices per pound can swing widely between stores, and loss-leader deals often appear in the two weeks before the holiday.
segments.tr: - **칠면조:** 많은 가정에서 가장 큰 지출 항목입니다. 파운드당 가격은 매장마다 크게 다를 수 있으며, 명절 2주 전에는 미끼 상품(loss-leader) 할인 행사가 자주 등장합니다.

segments.src: - **Eggs, butter and dairy:** These go into pies, stuffing and casseroles. Eggs in particular have been volatile in recent years, so check unit prices before stocking up.
segments.tr: - **달걀, 버터 및 유제품:** 파이, 스터핑, 캐서롤에 들어가는 재료입니다. 특히 달걀은 최근 몇 년간 가격 변동이 심했으므로, 대량 구매 전 단위 가격을 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **Baking staples:** Flour, sugar and shortening make up the pie crust. Store brands often match name brands at a lower price.
segments.tr: - **베이킹 필수품:** 밀가루, 설탕, 쇼트닝은 파이 크러스트를 만드는 데 필요합니다. 자체 브랜드(PB) 제품이 유명 브랜드 제품보다 저렴하면서도 품질은 비슷한 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: - **Spices:** Small jars add up, especially if you need several. Buying only what the recipes require, or using bulk sections, can trim the cost.
segments.tr: - **향신료:** 작은 병들이 모이면 비용이 꽤 커집니다. 특히 여러 종류가 필요할 때는 더욱 그렇습니다. 레시피에 필요한 만큼만 사거나 대용량 코너를 이용하면 비용을 절감할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Fresh produce:** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans and onions are seasonal and usually reasonable in November, though weather can change local pricing.
segments.tr: - **신선 농산물:** 감자, 고구마, 그린빈, 양파는 제철 채소라 11월에는 가격이 합리적인 편이지만, 날씨에 따라 지역별 가격이 달라질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Bread and stuffing mix:** Boxed mixes are convenient, but cubing day-old bread at home is often cheaper.
segments.tr: - **빵과 스터핑 믹스:** 박스형 믹스는 편리하지만, 하루 지난 빵을 집에서 직접 깍둑썰기하는 것이 보통 더 저렴합니다.

segments.src: ## How Families Are Trimming the Bill
segments.tr: ## 가족들이 식비를 절약하는 방법

segments.src: Shoppers have become practiced at holiday budgeting.
segments.tr: 쇼핑객들은 이제 명절 예산 관리에 익숙해졌습니다.

segments.src: Common strategies include:
segments.tr: 일반적인 전략은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Scaling the guest list or the menu.** A smaller turkey, or a turkey breast instead of a whole bird, reduces waste when fewer people are attending.
segments.tr: 1. **손님 명단이나 메뉴 조정하기.** 참석 인원이 적을 때는 더 작은 칠면조를 선택하거나 통칠면조 대신 칠면조 가슴살을 선택하면 음식물 쓰레기를 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Going potluck.** Assigning dishes to guests spreads both cost and effort.
segments.tr: 2. **포트럭 파티(각자 음식 가져오기) 하기.** 손님들에게 요리를 하나씩 맡기면 비용과 노력을 모두 분담할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Choosing store brands.** For canned pumpkin, broth, flour and sugar, the quality difference is often small.
segments.tr: 3. **자체 브랜드(PB) 제품 선택하기.** 호박 통조림, 육수, 밀가루, 설탕 등은 브랜드에 따른 품질 차이가 거의 없는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Using loyalty programs and digital coupons.** Many grocers offer turkey discounts tied to a minimum purchase, so it helps to read the terms.
segments.tr: 4. **로열티 프로그램 및 디지털 쿠폰 활용하기.** 많은 식료품점에서 일정 금액 이상 구매 시 칠면조 할인 혜택을 제공하므로, 이용 약관을 꼼꼼히 읽어보는 것이 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: 5. **Buying early and freezing.** Picking up a frozen turkey during early promotions can lock in a price, as long as freezer space allows.
segments.tr: 5. **일찍 구매해서 냉동하기.** 냉동고 공간만 충분하다면, 초기 할인 행사 기간에 냉동 칠면조를 미리 구매하여 가격을 고정해 둘 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 6. **Baking from scratch.** A homemade pie typically costs less than a bakery pie, though the savings shrink if you must buy many specialty ingredients.
segments.tr: 6. **직접 굽기.** 집에서 만든 파이는 보통 베이커리에서 산 파이보다 저렴하지만, 특수 재료를 많이 사야 한다면 절감 효과는 줄어듭니다.

segments.src: 7. **Planning for leftovers.** Soups, sandwiches and casseroles stretch the meal over several days and reduce food waste.
segments.tr: 7. **남은 음식 활용 계획 세우기.** 수프, 샌드위치, 캐서롤 등으로 활용하면 식사를 며칠 동안 이어갈 수 있고 음식물 쓰레기도 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## A Simple Way to Estimate Your Own Total
segments.tr: ## 나만의 총비용을 추산하는 간단한 방법

segments.src: Rather than relying on a headline number, build your own estimate:
segments.tr: 헤드라인 뉴스에 의존하기보다 직접 예산을 세워보세요:

segments.src: 1. Write down the dishes you plan to serve.
segments.tr: 1. 준비할 요리 목록을 적습니다.

segments.src: 2. List the ingredients, then check what is already in your pantry.
segments.tr: 2. 재료 목록을 작성한 뒤, 집에 이미 있는 재료를 확인합니다.

segments.src: 3. Compare prices at two or three stores, using unit prices rather than sticker prices.
segments.tr: 3. 두세 곳의 매장 가격을 비교하되, 표시 가격이 아닌 단위 가격을 기준으로 비교합니다.

segments.src: 4. Add a modest buffer, around ten percent, for items that run out or change in price.
segments.tr: 4. 재료가 부족하거나 가격이 변동될 경우를 대비해 약 10% 정도의 여유 예산을 추가합니다.

segments.src: 5. Set a ceiling before you shop and track the total as you go.
segments.tr: 5. 쇼핑 전 상한선을 정하고 쇼핑하면서 총액을 추적합니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The cost of Thanksgiving dinner in 2026 will depend less on any single factor than on where and how you shop.
segments.tr: 2026년 추수감사절 저녁 식사 비용은 단일 요인보다는 어디서, 어떻게 쇼핑하느냐에 따라 달라질 것입니다.

segments.src: Inflation, trade policy and poultry supply all play a role, but flexible planning, store promotions and a few smart substitutions can keep the meal affordable without losing what makes the day matter: the company around the table.
segments.tr: 물가 상승, 무역 정책, 가금류 공급 모두가 영향을 미치지만, 유연한 계획과 매장 프로모션 활용, 그리고 몇 가지 현명한 대체재 선택만으로도 추수감사절의 진정한 의미인 '식탁에 둘러앉은 소중한 사람들'을 잃지 않으면서도 합리적인 비용으로 식사를 준비할 수 있습니다.

zh.title: 感恩节餐桌账单：今年的火鸡、填料和派可能需要花多少钱

segments.src: Every November, the Thanksgiving shopping list doubles as a small economic report.
segments.tr: 每年十一月，感恩节购物清单都兼作一份小型经济报告。

segments.src: Turkey, stuffing, potatoes, cranberries and pie ingredients all land in the same cart, and the total tells families a lot about how far their budgets stretch.
segments.tr: 火鸡、填料、土豆、蔓越莓和派的原料都会装进同一个购物车，而总金额能让各个家庭清楚地了解自己的预算能支撑多久。

segments.src: This year, three forces are shaping that total: persistent grocery inflation, trade policy that affects some imported ingredients, and an uneven poultry supply.
segments.tr: 今年，有三种力量正在影响这一总额：持续的高食品通胀、影响部分进口原料的贸易政策，以及不稳定的家禽供应。

segments.src: This article is a general guide, not a price forecast.
segments.tr: 本文是一份通用指南，而非价格预测。

segments.src: Prices vary by region, store and week, so treat the trends below as a framework for planning rather than exact figures.
segments.tr: 价格因地区、门店和周次而异，因此请将以下趋势视为规划框架，而非精确数字。

segments.src: ## Why the Bill Looks Different in 2026
segments.tr: ## 为什么 2026 年的账单看起来有所不同

segments.src: ### Grocery prices remain elevated
segments.tr: ### 食品杂货价格居高不下

segments.src: Food prices have cooled from their peak rate of increase, but cooling inflation is not the same as falling prices.
segments.tr: 食品价格涨幅已从峰值放缓，但通胀降温并不等同于价格下跌。

segments.src: Many staples cost noticeably more than they did a few years ago, and shoppers still feel that gap at the register.
segments.tr: 许多主食的价格明显高于几年前，顾客在结账时依然能感受到这种差距。

segments.src: Labor, transportation and packaging costs continue to feed into shelf prices, even when ingredient costs ease.
segments.tr: 即便原料成本有所缓解，劳动力、运输和包装成本仍会继续推高货架价格。

segments.src: ### Tariffs and imported ingredients
segments.tr: ### 关税与进口原料

segments.src: Some Thanksgiving ingredients rely wholly or partly on imports.
segments.tr: 一些感恩节原料完全或部分依赖进口。

segments.src: Spices such as cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves, certain canned and packaged goods, and some specialty items can be affected when trade policy changes.
segments.tr: 当贸易政策发生变化时，肉桂、肉豆蔻和丁香等香料、某些罐头和包装食品以及一些特色商品可能会受到影响。

segments.src: Because tariffs are paid by importers, the extra cost may be absorbed, shared or passed on to shoppers, and the effect differs from product to product.
segments.tr: 由于关税由进口商支付，额外成本可能会被吸收、分摊或转嫁给消费者，其影响因产品而异。

segments.src: Expect the biggest impact on items with few domestic substitutes.
segments.tr: 预计缺乏国产替代品的商品受到的影响最大。

segments.src: Staples grown mostly in the United States, such as potatoes, cranberries and pumpkin, are generally less exposed.
segments.tr: 主要在美国本土种植的主食，如土豆、蔓越莓和南瓜，受到的影响通常较小。

segments.src: ### Shifting poultry supplies
segments.tr: ### 家禽供应的变化

segments.src: Turkey is the centerpiece, and its price depends on flock health and production decisions made months earlier.
segments.tr: 火鸡是重头戏，其价格取决于禽群健康状况以及数月前做出的生产决定。

segments.src: Outbreaks of avian disease in recent years have disrupted bird supplies at various points, and producers have been cautious about rebuilding.
segments.tr: 近年来的禽类疫情在不同节点打乱了禽类供应，生产商在恢复养殖规模方面一直较为谨慎。

segments.src: When supply is tight, whole frozen birds can be less available or more expensive, and retailers often respond with promotions to draw shoppers into stores.
segments.tr: 当供应紧张时，整只冻鸡可能较难买到或价格更高，而零售商往往会推出促销活动来吸引顾客进店。

segments.src: Watching weekly store flyers usually matters more than any national average.
segments.tr: 关注每周的门店促销海报通常比关注任何全国平均水平更有意义。

segments.src: ## Which Items Deserve a Closer Look
segments.tr: ## 哪些商品值得格外关注

segments.src: - **Turkey:** The biggest single line item for many households. Prices per pound can swing widely between stores, and loss-leader deals often appear in the two weeks before the holiday.
segments.tr: - **火鸡：** 许多家庭最大的单项开销。每磅价格在不同门店之间可能差异很大，而且在节日前两周通常会出现亏本甩卖的优惠。

segments.src: - **Eggs, butter and dairy:** These go into pies, stuffing and casseroles. Eggs in particular have been volatile in recent years, so check unit prices before stocking up.
segments.tr: - **鸡蛋、黄油和奶制品：** 这些是制作派、填料和烘焙菜肴的原料。尤其是鸡蛋，近年价格波动较大，因此在囤货前请先对比单价。

segments.src: - **Baking staples:** Flour, sugar and shortening make up the pie crust. Store brands often match name brands at a lower price.
segments.tr: - **烘焙主食：** 面粉、糖和起酥油构成派皮。自有品牌通常能以更低的价格提供不输知名品牌的品质。

segments.src: - **Spices:** Small jars add up, especially if you need several. Buying only what the recipes require, or using bulk sections, can trim the cost.
segments.tr: - **香料：** 小瓶装香料加起来可不便宜，特别是当你需要好几种时。仅购买食谱所需的量，或者使用散装区，可以节省成本。

segments.src: - **Fresh produce:** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans and onions are seasonal and usually reasonable in November, though weather can change local pricing.
segments.tr: - **新鲜农产品：** 土豆、红薯、绿豆和洋葱具有季节性，十一月的价格通常很合理，不过天气可能会改变局部定价。

segments.src: - **Bread and stuffing mix:** Boxed mixes are convenient, but cubing day-old bread at home is often cheaper.
segments.tr: - **面包和填料预拌粉：** 盒装预拌粉很方便，但在家把放了一天的面包切块通常更便宜。

segments.src: ## How Families Are Trimming the Bill
segments.tr: ## 各家庭如何精打细算削减账单

segments.src: Shoppers have become practiced at holiday budgeting.
segments.tr: 消费者在节日预算规划方面变得越来越有经验。

segments.src: Common strategies include:
segments.tr: 常见的策略包括：

segments.src: 1. **Scaling the guest list or the menu.** A smaller turkey, or a turkey breast instead of a whole bird, reduces waste when fewer people are attending.
segments.tr: 1. **精简客人名单或菜单。** 当到场人数较少时，选购较小的火鸡或火鸡胸肉代替整鸡可以减少浪费。

segments.src: 2. **Going potluck.** Assigning dishes to guests spreads both cost and effort.
segments.tr: 2. **采取百家宴（Potluck）形式。** 让客人各自带一道菜，可以分摊成本和精力。

segments.src: 3. **Choosing store brands.** For canned pumpkin, broth, flour and sugar, the quality difference is often small.
segments.tr: 3. **选择商店自有品牌。** 对于南瓜罐头、高汤、面粉和糖，品质差异往往微乎其微。

segments.src: 4. **Using loyalty programs and digital coupons.** Many grocers offer turkey discounts tied to a minimum purchase, so it helps to read the terms.
segments.tr: 4. **利用会员计划和数字优惠券。** 许多杂货店提供与最低消费挂钩的火鸡折扣，因此仔细阅读条款会有所帮助。

segments.src: 5. **Buying early and freezing.** Picking up a frozen turkey during early promotions can lock in a price, as long as freezer space allows.
segments.tr: 5. **尽早购买并冷冻。** 只要冷冻空间允许，在早期促销期间购买冻火鸡可以锁定价格。

segments.src: 6. **Baking from scratch.** A homemade pie typically costs less than a bakery pie, though the savings shrink if you must buy many specialty ingredients.
segments.tr: 6. **从零开始自制烘焙。** 自制的派通常比烘焙店买的便宜，但如果你必须购买许多特色原料，省下的钱就会变少。

segments.src: 7. **Planning for leftovers.** Soups, sandwiches and casseroles stretch the meal over several days and reduce food waste.
segments.tr: 7. **规划剩余食物。** 将剩菜做成汤、三明治和杂烩菜，可以将这顿大餐延续好几天，并减少食品浪费。

segments.src: ## A Simple Way to Estimate Your Own Total
segments.tr: ## 估算个人总开销的简单方法

segments.src: Rather than relying on a headline number, build your own estimate:
segments.tr: 与其依赖新闻上的概括数字，不如建立你自己的估算：

segments.src: 1. Write down the dishes you plan to serve.
segments.tr: 1. 写下你计划供应的菜肴。

segments.src: 2. List the ingredients, then check what is already in your pantry.
segments.tr: 2. 列出原料，然后检查食品柜里现有的物品。

segments.src: 3. Compare prices at two or three stores, using unit prices rather than sticker prices.
segments.tr: 3. 对比两三家门店的价格，使用单价而非标价进行比较。

segments.src: 4. Add a modest buffer, around ten percent, for items that run out or change in price.
segments.tr: 4. 加上大约百分之十的适度缓冲预算，以防物品用尽或价格变动。

segments.src: 5. Set a ceiling before you shop and track the total as you go.
segments.tr: 5. 在购物前设定上限，并在购物过程中实时记录总额。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The cost of Thanksgiving dinner in 2026 will depend less on any single factor than on where and how you shop.
segments.tr: 2026 年感恩节大餐的开销，与其说取决于单一因素，不如说取决于你在哪里以及如何购物。

segments.src: Inflation, trade policy and poultry supply all play a role, but flexible planning, store promotions and a few smart substitutions can keep the meal affordable without losing what makes the day matter: the company around the table.
segments.tr: 通胀、贸易政策和家禽供应都在起作用，但灵活的规划、门店促销和少许聪明的替代选择，就能在不失去节日核心意义——围坐在桌旁的情谊——的同时，让这顿饭保持实惠。

hi.title: थैंक्सगिविंग टेबल टैब: इस साल टर्की, स्टफिंग और पाई पर कितना खर्च हो सकता है

segments.src: Every November, the Thanksgiving shopping list doubles as a small economic report.
segments.tr: हर नवंबर, थैंक्सगिविंग की खरीदारी की सूची एक छोटी आर्थिक रिपोर्ट के रूप में भी काम करती है।

segments.src: Turkey, stuffing, potatoes, cranberries and pie ingredients all land in the same cart, and the total tells families a lot about how far their budgets stretch.
segments.tr: टर्की, स्टफिंग, आलू, क्रैनबेरी और पाई की सामग्री सभी एक ही कार्ट में आ जाती हैं, और कुल खर्च परिवारों को यह बताता है कि उनका बजट कितना खिंच सकता है।

segments.src: This year, three forces are shaping that total: persistent grocery inflation, trade policy that affects some imported ingredients, and an uneven poultry supply.
segments.tr: इस साल, तीन ताकतें उस कुल खर्च को आकार दे रही हैं: लगातार बढ़ती किराने की महंगाई, व्यापार नीति जो कुछ आयातित सामग्रियों को प्रभावित करती है, और पोल्ट्री की असमान आपूर्ति।

segments.src: This article is a general guide, not a price forecast.
segments.tr: यह लेख एक सामान्य मार्गदर्शिका है, न कि मूल्य का पूर्वानुमान।

segments.src: Prices vary by region, store and week, so treat the trends below as a framework for planning rather than exact figures.
segments.tr: कीमतें क्षेत्र, स्टोर और सप्ताह के अनुसार बदलती रहती हैं, इसलिए नीचे दिए गए रुझानों को सटीक आंकड़ों के बजाय योजना बनाने के लिए एक ढांचे के रूप में देखें।

segments.src: ## Why the Bill Looks Different in 2026
segments.tr: ## 2026 में बिल अलग क्यों दिखता है

segments.src: ### Grocery prices remain elevated
segments.tr: ### किराने की कीमतें ऊंची बनी हुई हैं

segments.src: Food prices have cooled from their peak rate of increase, but cooling inflation is not the same as falling prices.
segments.tr: खाद्य पदार्थों की कीमतें अपनी वृद्धि की चरम दर से कम हुई हैं, लेकिन महंगाई का कम होना कीमतों में गिरावट के समान नहीं है।

segments.src: Many staples cost noticeably more than they did a few years ago, and shoppers still feel that gap at the register.
segments.tr: कई मुख्य खाद्य पदार्थों की कीमत कुछ साल पहले की तुलना में काफी अधिक है, और खरीदार अभी भी रजिस्टर पर उस अंतर को महसूस करते हैं।

segments.src: Labor, transportation and packaging costs continue to feed into shelf prices, even when ingredient costs ease.
segments.tr: श्रम, परिवहन और पैकेजिंग की लागत शेल्फ की कीमतों में जुड़ती रहती है, भले ही सामग्री की लागत कम हो जाए।

segments.src: ### Tariffs and imported ingredients
segments.tr: ### टैरिफ और आयातित सामग्री

segments.src: Some Thanksgiving ingredients rely wholly or partly on imports.
segments.tr: थैंक्सगिविंग की कुछ सामग्रियां पूरी तरह या आंशिक रूप से आयात पर निर्भर करती हैं।

segments.src: Spices such as cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves, certain canned and packaged goods, and some specialty items can be affected when trade policy changes.
segments.tr: दालचीनी, जायफल और लौंग जैसे मसाले, कुछ डिब्बाबंद और पैक किए गए सामान, और कुछ विशेष वस्तुएं व्यापार नीति बदलने पर प्रभावित हो सकती हैं।

segments.src: Because tariffs are paid by importers, the extra cost may be absorbed, shared or passed on to shoppers, and the effect differs from product to product.
segments.tr: चूंकि टैरिफ का भुगतान आयातकों द्वारा किया जाता है, इसलिए अतिरिक्त लागत को अवशोषित किया जा सकता है, साझा किया जा सकता है या खरीदारों पर डाला जा सकता है, और इसका प्रभाव उत्पाद दर उत्पाद अलग होता है।

segments.src: Expect the biggest impact on items with few domestic substitutes.
segments.tr: उन वस्तुओं पर सबसे बड़े प्रभाव की अपेक्षा करें जिनका घरेलू विकल्प बहुत कम है।

segments.src: Staples grown mostly in the United States, such as potatoes, cranberries and pumpkin, are generally less exposed.
segments.tr: मुख्य रूप से संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में उगाए जाने वाले मुख्य खाद्य पदार्थ, जैसे आलू, क्रैनबेरी और कद्दू, आमतौर पर कम प्रभावित होते हैं।

segments.src: ### Shifting poultry supplies
segments.tr: ### पोल्ट्री आपूर्ति में बदलाव

segments.src: Turkey is the centerpiece, and its price depends on flock health and production decisions made months earlier.
segments.tr: टर्की मुख्य आकर्षण है, और इसकी कीमत झुंड के स्वास्थ्य और महीनों पहले लिए गए उत्पादन निर्णयों पर निर्भर करती है।

segments.src: Outbreaks of avian disease in recent years have disrupted bird supplies at various points, and producers have been cautious about rebuilding.
segments.tr: हाल के वर्षों में एवियन बीमारी के प्रकोप ने विभिन्न बिंदुओं पर पक्षियों की आपूर्ति को बाधित किया है, और उत्पादक पुनर्निर्माण के बारे में सतर्क रहे हैं।

segments.src: When supply is tight, whole frozen birds can be less available or more expensive, and retailers often respond with promotions to draw shoppers into stores.
segments.tr: जब आपूर्ति कम होती है, तो पूरे जमे हुए पक्षी कम उपलब्ध या अधिक महंगे हो सकते हैं, और खुदरा विक्रेता अक्सर खरीदारों को स्टोर में आकर्षित करने के लिए प्रचार के साथ प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं।

segments.src: Watching weekly store flyers usually matters more than any national average.
segments.tr: साप्ताहिक स्टोर फ्लायर्स को देखना आमतौर पर किसी भी राष्ट्रीय औसत से अधिक मायने रखता है।

segments.src: ## Which Items Deserve a Closer Look
segments.tr: ## किन वस्तुओं पर अधिक ध्यान देने की आवश्यकता है

segments.src: - **Turkey:** The biggest single line item for many households. Prices per pound can swing widely between stores, and loss-leader deals often appear in the two weeks before the holiday.
segments.tr: - **टर्की:** कई परिवारों के लिए सबसे बड़ी एकल मद। प्रति पाउंड कीमतें स्टोरों के बीच व्यापक रूप से बदल सकती हैं, और छुट्टी से दो सप्ताह पहले अक्सर नुकसान-नेता सौदे (loss-leader deals) दिखाई देते हैं।

segments.src: - **Eggs, butter and dairy:** These go into pies, stuffing and casseroles. Eggs in particular have been volatile in recent years, so check unit prices before stocking up.
segments.tr: - **अंडे, मक्खन और डेयरी:** ये पाई, स्टफिंग और कैसरोल में जाते हैं। विशेष रूप से अंडे हाल के वर्षों में अस्थिर रहे हैं, इसलिए स्टॉक करने से पहले प्रति यूनिट कीमतों की जांच करें।

segments.src: - **Baking staples:** Flour, sugar and shortening make up the pie crust. Store brands often match name brands at a lower price.
segments.tr: - **बेकिंग स्टेपल्स:** मैदा, चीनी और शॉर्टनिंग पाई क्रस्ट बनाते हैं। स्टोर ब्रांड अक्सर कम कीमत पर नामी ब्रांडों से मेल खाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Spices:** Small jars add up, especially if you need several. Buying only what the recipes require, or using bulk sections, can trim the cost.
segments.tr: - **मसाले:** छोटे जार की कीमत बढ़ जाती है, खासकर यदि आपको कई की आवश्यकता हो। केवल वही खरीदना जो व्यंजनों के लिए आवश्यक है, या थोक अनुभागों का उपयोग करना, लागत को कम कर सकता है।

segments.src: - **Fresh produce:** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans and onions are seasonal and usually reasonable in November, though weather can change local pricing.
segments.tr: - **ताजी उपज:** आलू, शकरकंद, हरी बीन्स और प्याज मौसमी हैं और नवंबर में आमतौर पर उचित होते हैं, हालांकि मौसम स्थानीय मूल्य निर्धारण को बदल सकता है।

segments.src: - **Bread and stuffing mix:** Boxed mixes are convenient, but cubing day-old bread at home is often cheaper.
segments.tr: - **ब्रेड और स्टफिंग मिक्स:** डिब्बाबंद मिक्स सुविधाजनक हैं, लेकिन घर पर एक दिन पुरानी ब्रेड को क्यूब्स में काटना अक्सर सस्ता होता है।

segments.src: ## How Families Are Trimming the Bill
segments.tr: ## परिवार बिल को कैसे कम कर रहे हैं

segments.src: Shoppers have become practiced at holiday budgeting.
segments.tr: खरीदार छुट्टी के बजट में अभ्यस्त हो गए हैं।

segments.src: Common strategies include:
segments.tr: सामान्य रणनीतियों में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Scaling the guest list or the menu.** A smaller turkey, or a turkey breast instead of a whole bird, reduces waste when fewer people are attending.
segments.tr: 1. **अतिथि सूची या मेनू को छोटा करना।** एक छोटा टर्की, या पूरे पक्षी के बजाय टर्की ब्रेस्ट, कम लोगों के आने पर बर्बादी को कम करता है।

segments.src: 2. **Going potluck.** Assigning dishes to guests spreads both cost and effort.
segments.tr: 2. **पॉटलक (Potluck) करना।** मेहमानों को व्यंजन सौंपने से लागत और प्रयास दोनों का बंटवारा होता है।

segments.src: 3. **Choosing store brands.** For canned pumpkin, broth, flour and sugar, the quality difference is often small.
segments.tr: 3. **स्टोर ब्रांड चुनना।** डिब्बाबंद कद्दू, शोरबा, मैदा और चीनी के लिए, गुणवत्ता का अंतर अक्सर छोटा होता है।

segments.src: 4. **Using loyalty programs and digital coupons.** Many grocers offer turkey discounts tied to a minimum purchase, so it helps to read the terms.
segments.tr: 4. **लॉयल्टी प्रोग्राम और डिजिटल कूपन का उपयोग करना।** कई किराने वाले न्यूनतम खरीदारी से जुड़ी टर्की छूट प्रदान करते हैं, इसलिए शर्तों को पढ़ना मददगार होता है।

segments.src: 5. **Buying early and freezing.** Picking up a frozen turkey during early promotions can lock in a price, as long as freezer space allows.
segments.tr: 5. **जल्दी खरीदना और फ्रीज करना।** शुरुआती प्रचारों के दौरान जमे हुए टर्की को लेने से कीमत लॉक हो सकती है, बशर्ते फ्रीजर में जगह हो।

segments.src: 6. **Baking from scratch.** A homemade pie typically costs less than a bakery pie, though the savings shrink if you must buy many specialty ingredients.
segments.tr: 6. **शुरुआत से बेक करना।** घर पर बनी पाई आमतौर पर बेकरी पाई से कम लागत वाली होती है, हालांकि अगर आपको कई विशेष सामग्री खरीदनी पड़ती है तो बचत कम हो जाती है।

segments.src: 7. **Planning for leftovers.** Soups, sandwiches and casseroles stretch the meal over several days and reduce food waste.
segments.tr: 7. **बचे हुए भोजन की योजना बनाना।** सूप, सैंडविच और कैसरोल भोजन को कई दिनों तक खींचते हैं और भोजन की बर्बादी को कम करते हैं।

segments.src: ## A Simple Way to Estimate Your Own Total
segments.tr: ## अपने स्वयं के कुल खर्च का अनुमान लगाने का एक सरल तरीका

segments.src: Rather than relying on a headline number, build your own estimate:
segments.tr: हेडलाइन नंबर पर भरोसा करने के बजाय, अपना खुद का अनुमान बनाएं:

segments.src: 1. Write down the dishes you plan to serve.
segments.tr: 1. उन व्यंजनों को लिखें जिन्हें आप परोसने की योजना बना रहे हैं।

segments.src: 2. List the ingredients, then check what is already in your pantry.

es.title: La cuenta de la mesa de Acción de Gracias: lo que podrían costar el pavo, el relleno y el pastel este año

segments.src: Every November, the Thanksgiving shopping list doubles as a small economic report.
segments.tr: Cada noviembre, la lista de la compra de Acción de Gracias funciona también como un pequeño informe económico.

segments.src: Turkey, stuffing, potatoes, cranberries and pie ingredients all land in the same cart, and the total tells families a lot about how far their budgets stretch.
segments.tr: El pavo, el relleno, las patatas, los arándanos y los ingredientes para los pasteles terminan en el mismo carrito, y el total les dice mucho a las familias sobre cuánto cunden sus presupuestos.

segments.src: This year, three forces are shaping that total: persistent grocery inflation, trade policy that affects some imported ingredients, and an uneven poultry supply.
segments.tr: Este año, tres fuerzas están dando forma a ese total: la persistente inflación de los alimentos, la política comercial que afecta a algunos ingredientes importados y un suministro avícola desigual.

segments.src: This article is a general guide, not a price forecast.
segments.tr: Este artículo es una guía general, no un pronóstico de precios.

segments.src: Prices vary by region, store and week, so treat the trends below as a framework for planning rather than exact figures.
segments.tr: Los precios varían según la región, la tienda y la semana, por lo que debe tomar las siguientes tendencias como un marco de planificación y no como cifras exactas.

segments.src: ## Why the Bill Looks Different in 2026
segments.tr: ## Por qué la cuenta se ve diferente en 2026

segments.src: ### Grocery prices remain elevated
segments.tr: ### Los precios de los alimentos se mantienen elevados

segments.src: Food prices have cooled from their peak rate of increase, but cooling inflation is not the same as falling prices.
segments.tr: Los precios de los alimentos se han moderado desde su ritmo máximo de aumento, pero una inflación a la baja no es lo mismo que una caída de precios.

segments.src: Many staples cost noticeably more than they did a few years ago, and shoppers still feel that gap at the register.
segments.tr: Muchos productos básicos cuestan notoriamente más que hace unos años, y los compradores aún sienten esa diferencia en la caja.

segments.src: Labor, transportation and packaging costs continue to feed into shelf prices, even when ingredient costs ease.
segments.tr: Los costes de mano de obra, transporte y embalaje siguen trasladándose a los precios en estantería, incluso cuando los costes de los ingredientes disminuyen.

segments.src: ### Tariffs and imported ingredients
segments.tr: ### Aranceles e ingredientes importados

segments.src: Some Thanksgiving ingredients rely wholly or partly on imports.
segments.tr: Algunos ingredientes de Acción de Gracias dependen total o parcialmente de las importaciones.

segments.src: Spices such as cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves, certain canned and packaged goods, and some specialty items can be affected when trade policy changes.
segments.tr: Especias como la canela, la nuez moscada y el clavo, ciertos productos enlatados y envasados, y algunas especialidades pueden verse afectados cuando cambia la política comercial.

segments.src: Because tariffs are paid by importers, the extra cost may be absorbed, shared or passed on to shoppers, and the effect differs from product to product.
segments.tr: Dado que los aranceles los pagan los importadores, el coste adicional puede absorberse, compartirse o trasladarse a los compradores, y el efecto difiere de un producto a otro.

segments.src: Expect the biggest impact on items with few domestic substitutes.
segments.tr: Prevea el mayor impacto en los productos con pocos sustitutos nacionales.

segments.src: Staples grown mostly in the United States, such as potatoes, cranberries and pumpkin, are generally less exposed.
segments.tr: Los productos básicos cultivados principalmente en los Estados Unidos, como las patatas, los arándanos y la calabaza, generalmente están menos expuestos.

segments.src: ### Shifting poultry supplies
segments.tr: ### Cambios en el suministro avícola

segments.src: Turkey is the centerpiece, and its price depends on flock health and production decisions made months earlier.
segments.tr: El pavo es el plato principal, y su precio depende de la salud de la parvada y de las decisiones de producción tomadas meses antes.

segments.src: Outbreaks of avian disease in recent years have disrupted bird supplies at various points, and producers have been cautious about rebuilding.
segments.tr: Los brotes de enfermedades aviares en los últimos años han interrumpido el suministro de aves en varios momentos, y los productores se han mostrado cautos a la hora de reconstruir la producción.

segments.src: When supply is tight, whole frozen birds can be less available or more expensive, and retailers often respond with promotions to draw shoppers into stores.
segments.tr: Cuando el suministro es escaso, las aves enteras congeladas pueden estar menos disponibles o ser más caras, y los minoristas suelen responder con promociones para atraer a los compradores a las tiendas.

segments.src: Watching weekly store flyers usually matters more than any national average.
segments.tr: Fijarse en los folletos semanales de las tiendas suele importar más que cualquier promedio nacional.

segments.src: ## Which Items Deserve a Closer Look
segments.tr: ## Qué artículos merecen una mirada más atenta

segments.src: - **Turkey:** The biggest single line item for many households. Prices per pound can swing widely between stores, and loss-leader deals often appear in the two weeks before the holiday.
segments.tr: - **Pavo:** El gasto individual más grande para muchos hogares. Los precios por libra pueden variar enormemente entre tiendas, y las ofertas con pérdidas gancho suelen aparecer en las dos semanas previas a la festividad.

segments.src: - **Eggs, butter and dairy:** These go into pies, stuffing and casseroles. Eggs in particular have been volatile in recent years, so check unit prices before stocking up.
segments.tr: - **Huevos, mantequilla y lácteos:** Se utilizan en pasteles, rellenos y guisos. Los huevos en particular han sido volátiles en los últimos años, así que consulte los precios unitarios antes de hacer acopio.

segments.src: - **Baking staples:** Flour, sugar and shortening make up the pie crust. Store brands often match name brands at a lower price.
segments.tr: - **Básicos de repostería:** La harina, el azúcar y la manteca forman la masa del pastel. Las marcas blancas a menudo igualan a las marcas comerciales a un precio más bajo.

segments.src: - **Spices:** Small jars add up, especially if you need several. Buying only what the recipes require, or using bulk sections, can trim the cost.
segments.tr: - **Especias:** Frascos pequeños pueden sumar bastante, especialmente si necesita varios. Comprar solo lo que requieren las recetas, o usar secciones a granel, puede reducir el coste.

segments.src: - **Fresh produce:** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans and onions are seasonal and usually reasonable in November, though weather can change local pricing.
segments.tr: - **Productos frescos:** Las patatas, los boniatos, las judías verdes y las cebollas son de temporada y suelen tener precios razonables en noviembre, aunque el clima puede alterar los precios locales.

segments.src: - **Bread and stuffing mix:** Boxed mixes are convenient, but cubing day-old bread at home is often cheaper.
segments.tr: - **Pan y mezcla de relleno:** Las mezclas en caja son cómodas, pero cortar en dados pan del día anterior en casa suele ser más barato.

segments.src: ## How Families Are Trimming the Bill
segments.tr: ## Cómo están reduciendo la cuenta las familias

segments.src: Shoppers have become practiced at holiday budgeting.
segments.tr: Los compradores han adquirido práctica en la elaboración de presupuestos festivos.

segments.src: Common strategies include:
segments.tr: Las estrategias comunes incluyen:

segments.src: 1. **Scaling the guest list or the menu.** A smaller turkey, or a turkey breast instead of a whole bird, reduces waste when fewer people are attending.
segments.tr: 1. **Ajustar la lista de invitados o el menú.** Un pavo más pequeño, o una pechuga de pavo en lugar de un ave entera, reduce el desperdicio cuando asisten menos personas.

segments.src: 2. **Going potluck.** Assigning dishes to guests spreads both cost and effort.
segments.tr: 2. **Hacer una comida compartida (potluck).** Asignar platos a los invitados distribuye tanto el coste como el esfuerzo.

segments.src: 3. **Choosing store brands.** For canned pumpkin, broth, flour and sugar, the quality difference is often small.
segments.tr: 3. **Elegir marcas de la tienda (marcas blancas).** Para la calabaza en lata, el caldo, la harina y el azúcar, la diferencia de calidad suele ser pequeña.

segments.src: 4. **Using loyalty programs and digital coupons.** Many grocers offer turkey discounts tied to a minimum purchase, so it helps to read the terms.
segments.tr: 4. **Usar programas de fidelización y cupones digitales.** Muchos supermercados ofrecen descuentos en pavos vinculados a una compra mínima, por lo que conviene leer las condiciones.

segments.src: 5. **Buying early and freezing.** Picking up a frozen turkey during early promotions can lock in a price, as long as freezer space allows.
segments.tr: 5. **Comprar con antelación y congelar.** Comprar un pavo congelado durante las primeras promociones puede asegurar el precio, siempre que el espacio en el congelador lo permita.

segments.src: 6. **Baking from scratch.** A homemade pie typically costs less than a bakery pie, though the savings shrink if you must buy many specialty ingredients.
segments.tr: 6. **Hornear desde cero.** Un pastel casero suele costar menos que uno de pastelería, aunque el ahorro se reduce si debe comprar muchos ingredientes especiales.

segments.src: 7. **Planning for leftovers.** Soups, sandwiches and casseroles stretch the meal over several days and reduce food waste.
segments.tr: 7. **Planificar las sobras.** Las sopas, bocadillos y guisos rinden la comida durante varios días y reducen el desperdicio de alimentos.

segments.src: ## A Simple Way to Estimate Your Own Total
segments.tr: ## Una forma sencilla de estimar su propio total

segments.src: Rather than relying on a headline number, build your own estimate:
segments.tr: En lugar de confiar en una cifra titular, elabore su propia estimación:

segments.src: 1. Write down the dishes you plan to serve.
segments.tr: 1. Anote los platos que planea servir.

segments.src: 2. List the ingredients, then check what is already in your pantry.
segments.tr: 2. Enumere los ingredientes y luego compruebe lo que ya tiene en su despensa.

segments.src: 3. Compare prices at two or three stores, using unit prices rather than sticker prices.
segments.tr: 3. Compare precios en dos o tres tiendas, utilizando precios unitarios en lugar de precios de etiqueta.

segments.src: 4. Add a modest buffer, around ten percent, for items that run out or change in price.
segments.tr: 4. Añada un margen modesto, de alrededor del diez por ciento, para los artículos que se agoten o cambien de precio.

segments.src: 5. Set a ceiling before you shop and track the total as you go.
segments.tr: 5. Establezca un límite máximo antes de comprar y realice un seguimiento del total a medida que avanza.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: The cost of Thanksgiving dinner in 2026 will depend less on any single factor than on where and how you shop.
segments.tr: El coste de la cena de Acción de Gracias en 2026 dependerá menos de un solo factor que de dónde y cómo haga sus compras.

segments.src: Inflation, trade policy and poultry supply all play a role, but flexible planning, store promotions and a few smart substitutions can keep the meal affordable without losing what makes the day matter: the company around the table.
segments.tr: La inflación, la política comercial y el suministro de aves desempeñan un papel, pero una planificación flexible, las promociones de las tiendas y algunas sustituciones inteligentes pueden mantener la comida asequible sin perder lo que hace que el día importe: la compañía alrededor de la mesa.

fr.title: L'onglet de la table de Thanksgiving : combien pourraient coûter la dinde, la farce et la tarte cette année

segments.src: Every November, the Thanksgiving shopping list doubles as a small economic report.
segments.tr: Chaque mois de novembre, la liste de courses pour Thanksgiving fait office de petit rapport économique.

segments.src: Turkey, stuffing, potatoes, cranberries and pie ingredients all land in the same cart, and the total tells families a lot about how far their budgets stretch.
segments.tr: La dinde, la farce, les pommes de terre, les canneberges et les ingrédients pour la tarte finissent tous dans le même caddie, et le total en dit long aux familles sur la marge de manœuvre de leur budget.

segments.src: This year, three forces are shaping that total: persistent grocery inflation, trade policy that affects some imported ingredients, and an uneven poultry supply.
segments.tr: Cette année, trois facteurs influencent ce total : l'inflation persistante des produits alimentaires, la politique commerciale qui affecte certains ingrédients importés et une offre de volaille inégale.

segments.src: This article is a general guide, not a price forecast.
segments.tr: Cet article est un guide général, pas une prévision de prix.

segments.src: Prices vary by region, store and week, so treat the trends below as a framework for planning rather than exact figures.
segments.tr: Les prix varient selon la région, le magasin et la semaine, alors considérez les tendances ci-dessous comme un cadre de planification plutôt que comme des chiffres exacts.

segments.src: ## Why the Bill Looks Different in 2026
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la facture semble différente en 2026

segments.src: ### Grocery prices remain elevated
segments.tr: ### Les prix des produits alimentaires restent élevés

segments.src: Food prices have cooled from their peak rate of increase, but cooling inflation is not the same as falling prices.
segments.tr: Les prix des denrées alimentaires ont ralenti par rapport à leur taux d'augmentation maximal, mais un ralentissement de l'inflation n'est pas la même chose qu'une baisse des prix.

segments.src: Many staples cost noticeably more than they did a few years ago, and shoppers still feel that gap at the register.
segments.tr: De nombreux produits de base coûtent nettement plus cher qu'il y a quelques années, et les acheteurs ressentent toujours cet écart à la caisse.

segments.src: Labor, transportation and packaging costs continue to feed into shelf prices, even when ingredient costs ease.
segments.tr: Les coûts de main-d'œuvre, de transport et d'emballage continuent d'alimenter les prix en rayon, même lorsque le coût des ingrédients diminue.

segments.src: ### Tariffs and imported ingredients
segments.tr: ### Tarifs douaniers et ingrédients importés

segments.src: Some Thanksgiving ingredients rely wholly or partly on imports.
segments.tr: Certains ingrédients de Thanksgiving dépendent entièrement ou partiellement des importations.

segments.src: Spices such as cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves, certain canned and packaged goods, and some specialty items can be affected when trade policy changes.
segments.tr: Les épices comme la cannelle, la muscade et les clous de girofle, certains produits en conserve et emballés, ainsi que certains articles spécialisés peuvent être affectés lorsque la politique commerciale change.

segments.src: Because tariffs are paid by importers, the extra cost may be absorbed, shared or passed on to shoppers, and the effect differs from product to product.
segments.tr: Comme les droits de douane sont payés par les importateurs, le coût supplémentaire peut être absorbé, partagé ou répercuté sur les acheteurs, et l'effet diffère d'un produit à l'autre.

segments.src: Expect the biggest impact on items with few domestic substitutes.
segments.tr: Attendez-vous au plus gros impact sur les articles ayant peu de substituts nationaux.

segments.src: Staples grown mostly in the United States, such as potatoes, cranberries and pumpkin, are generally less exposed.
segments.tr: Les produits de base cultivés principalement aux États-Unis, tels que les pommes de terre, les canneberges et la citrouille, sont généralement moins exposés.

segments.src: ### Shifting poultry supplies
segments.tr: ### Évolution de l'offre de volaille

segments.src: Turkey is the centerpiece, and its price depends on flock health and production decisions made months earlier.
segments.tr: La dinde est la pièce maîtresse, et son prix dépend de la santé des élevages et des décisions de production prises des mois plus tôt.

segments.src: Outbreaks of avian disease in recent years have disrupted bird supplies at various points, and producers have been cautious about rebuilding.
segments.tr: Les épidémies de maladies aviaires ces dernières années ont perturbé l'approvisionnement en volailles à divers moments, et les producteurs ont été prudents quant à la reconstitution des stocks.

segments.src: When supply is tight, whole frozen birds can be less available or more expensive, and retailers often respond with promotions to draw shoppers into stores.
segments.tr: Lorsque l'offre est limitée, les oiseaux entiers congelés peuvent être moins disponibles ou plus chers, et les détaillants réagissent souvent par des promotions pour attirer les clients dans les magasins.

segments.src: Watching weekly store flyers usually matters more than any national average.
segments.tr: Consulter les prospectus hebdomadaires des magasins compte généralement plus que n'importe quelle moyenne nationale.

segments.src: ## Which Items Deserve a Closer Look
segments.tr: ## Quels articles méritent une attention particulière

segments.src: - **Turkey:** The biggest single line item for many households. Prices per pound can swing widely between stores, and loss-leader deals often appear in the two weeks before the holiday.
segments.tr: - **Dinde :** Le poste de dépense le plus important pour de nombreux ménages. Les prix au kilo peuvent varier considérablement d'un magasin à l'autre, et des offres d'appel apparaissent souvent dans les deux semaines précédant la fête.

segments.src: - **Eggs, butter and dairy:** These go into pies, stuffing and casseroles. Eggs in particular have been volatile in recent years, so check unit prices before stocking up.
segments.tr: - **Œufs, beurre et produits laitiers :** Ils entrent dans la composition des tartes, des farces et des gratins. Les œufs en particulier ont été volatils ces dernières années, alors vérifiez les prix unitaires avant de faire des stocks.

segments.src: - **Baking staples:** Flour, sugar and shortening make up the pie crust. Store brands often match name brands at a lower price.
segments.tr: - **Ingrédients de pâtisserie :** La farine, le sucre et la matière grasse composent la pâte à tarte. Les marques de distributeur égalent souvent les grandes marques à un prix inférieur.

segments.src: - **Spices:** Small jars add up, especially if you need several. Buying only what the recipes require, or using bulk sections, can trim the cost.
segments.tr: - **Épices :** Les petits pots s'additionnent, surtout si vous en avez besoin de plusieurs. N'acheter que ce que les recettes exigent, ou utiliser les sections en vrac, peut réduire le coût.

segments.src: - **Fresh produce:** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans and onions are seasonal and usually reasonable in November, though weather can change local pricing.
segments.tr: - **Produits frais :** Les pommes de terre, les patates douces, les haricots verts et les oignons sont de saison et généralement abordables en novembre, bien que la météo puisse modifier les prix locaux.

segments.src: - **Bread and stuffing mix:** Boxed mixes are convenient, but cubing day-old bread at home is often cheaper.
segments.tr: - **Pain et mélange pour farce :** Les mélanges en boîte sont pratiques, mais couper du pain rassis en cubes à la maison est souvent moins cher.

segments.src: ## How Families Are Trimming the Bill
segments.tr: ## Comment les familles réduisent la facture

segments.src: Shoppers have become practiced at holiday budgeting.
segments.tr: Les acheteurs sont devenus habitués à la budgétisation des fêtes.

segments.src: Common strategies include:
segments.tr: Les stratégies courantes incluent :

segments.src: 1. **Scaling the guest list or the menu.** A smaller turkey, or a turkey breast instead of a whole bird, reduces waste when fewer people are attending.
segments.tr: 1. **Réduire la liste des invités ou le menu.** Une dinde plus petite, ou un blanc de dinde au lieu d'un oiseau entier, réduit le gaspillage lorsque moins de personnes sont présentes.

segments.src: 2. **Going potluck.** Assigning dishes to guests spreads both cost and effort.
segments.tr: 2. **Opter pour un repas partagé (potluck).** Attribuer des plats aux invités répartit à la fois le coût et l'effort.

segments.src: 3. **Choosing store brands.** For canned pumpkin, broth, flour and sugar, the quality difference is often small.
segments.tr: 3. **Choisir les marques de distributeur.** Pour la citrouille en conserve, le bouillon, la farine et le sucre, la différence de qualité est souvent minime.

segments.src: 4. **Using loyalty programs and digital coupons.** Many grocers offer turkey discounts tied to a minimum purchase, so it helps to read the terms.
segments.tr: 4. **Utiliser les programmes de fidélité et les coupons numériques.** De nombreux épiciers proposent des réductions sur la dinde liées à un achat minimum, il est donc utile de lire les conditions.

segments.src: 5. **Buying early and freezing.** Picking up a frozen turkey during early promotions can lock in a price, as long as freezer space allows.
segments.tr: 5. **Acheter tôt et congeler.** Acheter une dinde congelée pendant les premières promotions peut bloquer un prix, tant que l'espace au congélateur le permet.

segments.src: 6. **Baking from scratch.** A homemade pie typically costs less than a bakery pie, though the savings shrink if you must buy many specialty ingredients.
segments.tr: 6. **Cuisiner maison.** Une tarte faite maison coûte généralement moins cher qu'une tarte de boulangerie, bien que les économies diminuent si vous devez acheter de nombreux ingrédients spécialisés.

segments.src: 7. **Planning for leftovers.** Soups, sandwiches and casseroles stretch the meal over several days and reduce food waste.
segments.tr: 7. **Prévoir les restes.** Les soupes, les sandwichs et les gratins permettent d'étaler le repas sur plusieurs jours et de réduire le gaspillage alimentaire.

segments.tr: 5. Fixez un plafond avant de faire vos courses et suivez le total au fur et à mesure.

in.title: Tab Meja Thanksgiving: Berapa Biaya Kalkun, Isian, dan Pai Tahun Ini

segments.src: Every November, the Thanksgiving shopping list doubles as a small economic report.
segments.tr: Setiap bulan November, daftar belanja Thanksgiving juga berfungsi sebagai laporan ekonomi kecil.

segments.src: Turkey, stuffing, potatoes, cranberries and pie ingredients all land in the same cart, and the total tells families a lot about how far their budgets stretch.
segments.tr: Kalkun, isian, kentang, cranberry, dan bahan-bahan pai semuanya masuk ke dalam keranjang yang sama, dan totalnya memberi tahu keluarga banyak hal tentang seberapa jauh anggaran mereka dapat digunakan.

segments.src: This year, three forces are shaping that total: persistent grocery inflation, trade policy that affects some imported ingredients, and an uneven poultry supply.
segments.tr: Tahun ini, tiga kekuatan membentuk total tersebut: inflasi bahan makanan yang terus-menerus, kebijakan perdagangan yang memengaruhi beberapa bahan impor, dan pasokan unggas yang tidak merata.

segments.src: This article is a general guide, not a price forecast.
segments.tr: Artikel ini adalah panduan umum, bukan prakiraan harga.

segments.src: Prices vary by region, store and week, so treat the trends below as a framework for planning rather than exact figures.
segments.tr: Harga bervariasi menurut wilayah, toko, dan minggu, jadi perlakukan tren di bawah ini sebagai kerangka kerja untuk perencanaan daripada angka pasti.

segments.src: ## Why the Bill Looks Different in 2026
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Tagihan Terlihat Berbeda di 2026

segments.src: ### Grocery prices remain elevated
segments.tr: ### Harga bahan makanan tetap tinggi

segments.src: Food prices have cooled from their peak rate of increase, but cooling inflation is not the same as falling prices.
segments.tr: Harga pangan telah mendingin dari tingkat kenaikan puncaknya, tetapi inflasi yang mendingin tidak sama dengan harga yang turun.

segments.src: Many staples cost noticeably more than they did a few years ago, and shoppers still feel that gap at the register.
segments.tr: Banyak bahan pokok harganya jauh lebih mahal daripada beberapa tahun yang lalu, dan pembeli masih merasakan kesenjangan itu di kasir.

segments.src: Labor, transportation and packaging costs continue to feed into shelf prices, even when ingredient costs ease.
segments.tr: Biaya tenaga kerja, transportasi, dan pengemasan terus memengaruhi harga di rak, bahkan ketika biaya bahan baku mereda.

segments.src: ### Tariffs and imported ingredients
segments.tr: ### Tarif dan bahan impor

segments.src: Some Thanksgiving ingredients rely wholly or partly on imports.
segments.tr: Beberapa bahan Thanksgiving bergantung sepenuhnya atau sebagian pada impor.

segments.src: Spices such as cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves, certain canned and packaged goods, and some specialty items can be affected when trade policy changes.
segments.tr: Rempah-rempah seperti kayu manis, pala, dan cengkeh, barang kaleng dan kemasan tertentu, serta beberapa barang khusus dapat terpengaruh ketika kebijakan perdagangan berubah.

segments.src: Because tariffs are paid by importers, the extra cost may be absorbed, shared or passed on to shoppers, and the effect differs from product to product.
segments.tr: Karena tarif dibayar oleh importir, biaya tambahan mungkin diserap, dibagi, atau dibebankan kepada pembeli, dan efeknya berbeda dari satu produk ke produk lainnya.

segments.src: Expect the biggest impact on items with few domestic substitutes.
segments.tr: Harapkan dampak terbesar pada barang-barang dengan sedikit pengganti domestik.

segments.src: Staples grown mostly in the United States, such as potatoes, cranberries and pumpkin, are generally less exposed.
segments.tr: Bahan pokok yang sebagian besar ditanam di Amerika Serikat, seperti kentang, cranberry, dan labu, umumnya kurang terpapar.

segments.src: ### Shifting poultry supplies
segments.tr: ### Pergeseran pasokan unggas

segments.src: Turkey is the centerpiece, and its price depends on flock health and production decisions made months earlier.
segments.tr: Kalkun adalah hidangan utama, dan harganya bergantung pada kesehatan kawanan dan keputusan produksi yang dibuat berbulan-bulan sebelumnya.

segments.src: Outbreaks of avian disease in recent years have disrupted bird supplies at various points, and producers have been cautious about rebuilding.
segments.tr: Wabah penyakit unggas dalam beberapa tahun terakhir telah mengganggu pasokan burung di berbagai titik, dan produsen berhati-hati dalam membangun kembali.

segments.src: When supply is tight, whole frozen birds can be less available or more expensive, and retailers often respond with promotions to draw shoppers into stores.
segments.tr: Ketika pasokan ketat, burung beku utuh bisa lebih sulit didapat atau lebih mahal, dan pengecer sering merespons dengan promosi untuk menarik pembeli ke toko.

segments.src: Watching weekly store flyers usually matters more than any national average.
segments.tr: Melihat selebaran toko mingguan biasanya lebih penting daripada rata-rata nasional mana pun.

segments.src: ## Which Items Deserve a Closer Look
segments.tr: ## Barang Mana yang Perlu Diperhatikan Lebih Dekat

segments.src: - **Turkey:** The biggest single line item for many households. Prices per pound can swing widely between stores, and loss-leader deals often appear in the two weeks before the holiday.
segments.tr: - **Kalkun:** Satu item terbesar bagi banyak rumah tangga. Harga per pon bisa berayun lebar antar toko, dan penawaran harga rugi sering muncul dalam dua minggu sebelum liburan.

segments.src: - **Eggs, butter and dairy:** These go into pies, stuffing and casseroles. Eggs in particular have been volatile in recent years, so check unit prices before stocking up.
segments.tr: - **Telur, mentega, dan produk susu:** Ini masuk ke dalam pai, isian, dan kaserol. Telur khususnya telah fluktuatif dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, jadi periksa harga satuan sebelum menimbun.

segments.src: - **Baking staples:** Flour, sugar and shortening make up the pie crust. Store brands often match name brands at a lower price.
segments.tr: - **Bahan pokok kue:** Tepung, gula, dan mentega putih membentuk kulit pai. Merek toko sering kali menyamai merek ternama dengan harga lebih rendah.

segments.src: - **Spices:** Small jars add up, especially if you need several. Buying only what the recipes require, or using bulk sections, can trim the cost.
segments.tr: - **Rempah-rempah:** Stoples kecil menambah biaya, terutama jika Anda membutuhkan beberapa. Membeli hanya apa yang dibutuhkan resep, atau menggunakan bagian curah, dapat memangkas biaya.

segments.src: - **Fresh produce:** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans and onions are seasonal and usually reasonable in November, though weather can change local pricing.
segments.tr: - **Produk segar:** Kentang, ubi jalar, buncis, dan bawang bombay bersifat musiman dan biasanya masuk akal di bulan November, meskipun cuaca dapat mengubah harga lokal.

segments.src: - **Bread and stuffing mix:** Boxed mixes are convenient, but cubing day-old bread at home is often cheaper.
segments.tr: - **Roti dan campuran isian:** Campuran kotak memang praktis, tetapi memotong roti sisa sehari di rumah sering kali lebih murah.

segments.src: ## How Families Are Trimming the Bill
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Keluarga Memangkas Tagihan

segments.src: Shoppers have become practiced at holiday budgeting.
segments.tr: Pembeli telah terbiasa dengan penganggaran liburan.

segments.src: Common strategies include:
segments.tr: Strategi umum meliputi:

segments.src: 1. **Scaling the guest list or the menu.** A smaller turkey, or a turkey breast instead of a whole bird, reduces waste when fewer people are attending.
segments.tr: 1. **Menyesuaikan daftar tamu atau menu.** Kalkun yang lebih kecil, atau dada kalkun alih-alih burung utuh, mengurangi limbah ketika lebih sedikit orang yang hadir.

segments.src: 2. **Going potluck.** Assigning dishes to guests spreads both cost and effort.
segments.tr: 2. **Mengadakan potluck.** Menugaskan hidangan kepada tamu menyebarkan biaya dan usaha.

segments.src: 3. **Choosing store brands.** For canned pumpkin, broth, flour and sugar, the quality difference is often small.
segments.tr: 3. **Memilih merek toko.** Untuk labu kaleng, kaldu, tepung, dan gula, perbedaan kualitasnya sering kali kecil.

segments.src: 4. **Using loyalty programs and digital coupons.** Many grocers offer turkey discounts tied to a minimum purchase, so it helps to read the terms.
segments.tr: 4. **Menggunakan program loyalitas dan kupon digital.** Banyak toko bahan makanan menawarkan diskon kalkun yang terikat pada pembelian minimum, jadi ada baiknya membaca persyaratannya.

segments.src: 5. **Buying early and freezing.** Picking up a frozen turkey during early promotions can lock in a price, as long as freezer space allows.
segments.tr: 5. **Membeli lebih awal dan membekukan.** Mengambil kalkun beku selama promosi awal dapat mengunci harga, selama ruang freezer memungkinkan.

segments.src: 6. **Baking from scratch.** A homemade pie typically costs less than a bakery pie, though the savings shrink if you must buy many specialty ingredients.
segments.tr: 6. **Membuat kue dari awal.** Pai buatan sendiri biasanya lebih murah daripada pai toko roti, meskipun penghematan berkurang jika Anda harus membeli banyak bahan khusus.

segments.src: 7. **Planning for leftovers.** Soups, sandwiches and casseroles stretch the meal over several days and reduce food waste.
segments.tr: 7. **Merencanakan sisa makanan.** Sup, sandwich, dan kaserol memperpanjang makanan selama beberapa hari dan mengurangi limbah makanan.

segments.src: ## A Simple Way to Estimate Your Own Total
segments.tr: ## Cara Sederhana untuk Memperkirakan Total Anda Sendiri

segments.src: 5. Set a ceiling before you shop and track the total as you go.
segments.tr: 5. Tetapkan batas atas sebelum Anda berbelanja dan lacak totalnya saat Anda berbelanja.

de.title: Der Thanksgiving-Tisch: Was Truthahn, Füllung und Kuchen dieses Jahr kosten könnten

segments.src: Every November, the Thanksgiving shopping list doubles as a small economic report.
segments.tr: Jeden November dient die Thanksgiving-Einkaufsliste gleichzeitig als kleiner Wirtschaftsbericht.

segments.src: Turkey, stuffing, potatoes, cranberries and pie ingredients all land in the same cart, and the total tells families a lot about how far their budgets stretch.
segments.tr: Truthahn, Füllung, Kartoffeln, Preiselbeeren und Zutaten für Kuchen landen alle im selben Einkaufswagen, und die Gesamtsumme verrät Familien viel darüber, wie weit ihr Budget reicht.

segments.src: This year, three forces are shaping that total: persistent grocery inflation, trade policy that affects some imported ingredients, and an uneven poultry supply.
segments.tr: Dieses Jahr bestimmen drei Faktoren diese Summe: anhaltende Lebensmittelinflation, Handelspolitik, die sich auf einige importierte Zutaten auswirkt, und ein ungleichmäßiges Geflügelangebot.

segments.src: This article is a general guide, not a price forecast.
segments.tr: Dieser Artikel ist ein allgemeiner Leitfaden, keine Preisprognose.

segments.src: Prices vary by region, store and week, so treat the trends below as a framework for planning rather than exact figures.
segments.tr: Die Preise variieren je nach Region, Geschäft und Woche. Betrachten Sie die folgenden Trends daher eher als Rahmen für Ihre Planung und nicht als exakte Zahlen.

segments.src: ## Why the Bill Looks Different in 2026
segments.tr: ## Warum die Rechnung im Jahr 2026 anders aussieht

segments.src: ### Grocery prices remain elevated
segments.tr: ### Lebensmittelpreise bleiben erhöht

segments.src: Food prices have cooled from their peak rate of increase, but cooling inflation is not the same as falling prices.
segments.tr: Die Lebensmittelpreise haben sich von ihrer höchsten Steigerungsrate abgekühlt, aber eine nachlassende Inflation ist nicht dasselbe wie sinkende Preise.

segments.src: Many staples cost noticeably more than they did a few years ago, and shoppers still feel that gap at the register.
segments.tr: Viele Grundnahrungsmittel kosten spürbar mehr als noch vor ein paar Jahren, und die Käufer spüren diese Lücke immer noch an der Kasse.

segments.src: Labor, transportation and packaging costs continue to feed into shelf prices, even when ingredient costs ease.
segments.tr: Arbeits-, Transport- und Verpackungskosten fließen weiterhin in die Ladenpreise ein, selbst wenn die Zutatenkosten sinken.

segments.src: ### Tariffs and imported ingredients
segments.tr: ### Zölle und importierte Zutaten

segments.src: Some Thanksgiving ingredients rely wholly or partly on imports.
segments.tr: Einige Thanksgiving-Zutaten sind ganz oder teilweise auf Importe angewiesen.

segments.src: Spices such as cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves, certain canned and packaged goods, and some specialty items can be affected when trade policy changes.
segments.tr: Gewürze wie Zimt, Muskatnuss und Nelken, bestimmte Konserven und verpackte Waren sowie einige Spezialitäten können betroffen sein, wenn sich die Handelspolitik ändert.

segments.src: Because tariffs are paid by importers, the extra cost may be absorbed, shared or passed on to shoppers, and the effect differs from product to product.
segments.tr: Da Zölle von Importeuren gezahlt werden, können die Mehrkosten absorbiert, geteilt oder an die Käufer weitergegeben werden, wobei die Auswirkungen von Produkt zu Produkt unterschiedlich sind.

segments.src: Expect the biggest impact on items with few domestic substitutes.
segments.tr: Erwarten Sie die größten Auswirkungen bei Artikeln mit wenigen inländischen Ersatzprodukten.

segments.src: Staples grown mostly in the United States, such as potatoes, cranberries and pumpkin, are generally less exposed.
segments.tr: Grundnahrungsmittel, die hauptsächlich in den Vereinigten Staaten angebaut werden, wie Kartoffeln, Preiselbeeren und Kürbis, sind im Allgemeinen weniger betroffen.

segments.src: ### Shifting poultry supplies
segments.tr: ### Sich verändernde Geflügelvorräte

segments.src: Turkey is the centerpiece, and its price depends on flock health and production decisions made months earlier.
segments.tr: Der Truthahn ist das Herzstück, und sein Preis hängt von der Gesundheit der Bestände und den Produktionsentscheidungen ab, die Monate zuvor getroffen wurden.

segments.src: Outbreaks of avian disease in recent years have disrupted bird supplies at various points, and producers have been cautious about rebuilding.
segments.tr: Ausbrüche von Geflügelkrankheiten in den letzten Jahren haben die Vogelbestände zu verschiedenen Zeitpunkten gestört, und die Erzeuger waren beim Wiederaufbau vorsichtig.

segments.src: When supply is tight, whole frozen birds can be less available or more expensive, and retailers often respond with promotions to draw shoppers into stores.
segments.tr: Wenn das Angebot knapp ist, sind ganze gefrorene Vögel möglicherweise weniger verfügbar oder teurer, und Einzelhändler reagieren oft mit Werbeaktionen, um Käufer in die Geschäfte zu locken.

segments.src: Watching weekly store flyers usually matters more than any national average.
segments.tr: Das Beobachten der wöchentlichen Werbeflyer der Geschäfte ist meist wichtiger als jeder nationale Durchschnitt.

segments.src: ## Which Items Deserve a Closer Look
segments.tr: ## Welche Artikel einen genaueren Blick verdienen

segments.src: - **Turkey:** The biggest single line item for many households. Prices per pound can swing widely between stores, and loss-leader deals often appear in the two weeks before the holiday.
segments.tr: - **Truthahn:** Für viele Haushalte der größte einzelne Posten. Die Preise pro Pfund können zwischen den Geschäften stark schwanken, und Lockvogelangebote tauchen oft in den zwei Wochen vor dem Feiertag auf.

segments.src: - **Eggs, butter and dairy:** These go into pies, stuffing and casseroles. Eggs in particular have been volatile in recent years, so check unit prices before stocking up.
segments.tr: - **Eier, Butter und Milchprodukte:** Diese kommen in Kuchen, Füllungen und Aufläufe. Insbesondere Eier waren in den letzten Jahren volatil, prüfen Sie also die Stückpreise, bevor Sie sich eindecken.

segments.src: - **Baking staples:** Flour, sugar and shortening make up the pie crust. Store brands often match name brands at a lower price.
segments.tr: - **Backzutaten:** Mehl, Zucker und Backfett bilden die Kruste für den Kuchen. Handelsmarken sind oft genauso gut wie Markenprodukte, aber günstiger.

segments.src: - **Spices:** Small jars add up, especially if you need several. Buying only what the recipes require, or using bulk sections, can trim the cost.
segments.tr: - **Gewürze:** Kleine Gläser summieren sich, besonders wenn Sie mehrere benötigen. Nur das zu kaufen, was die Rezepte erfordern, oder lose Ware zu verwenden, kann die Kosten senken.

segments.src: - **Fresh produce:** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans and onions are seasonal and usually reasonable in November, though weather can change local pricing.
segments.tr: - **Frische Produkte:** Kartoffeln, Süßkartoffeln, grüne Bohnen und Zwiebeln sind saisonal und im November normalerweise günstig, obwohl das Wetter die lokalen Preise beeinflussen kann.

segments.src: - **Bread and stuffing mix:** Boxed mixes are convenient, but cubing day-old bread at home is often cheaper.
segments.tr: - **Brot und Füllungsmischung:** Fertigmischungen aus der Schachtel sind praktisch, aber zu Hause gewürfeltes Brot vom Vortag ist oft billiger.

segments.src: ## How Families Are Trimming the Bill
segments.tr: ## Wie Familien die Rechnung kürzen

segments.src: Shoppers have become practiced at holiday budgeting.
segments.tr: Die Käufer haben Übung im Budgetieren für die Feiertage.

segments.src: Common strategies include:
segments.tr: Zu den gängigen Strategien gehören:

segments.src: 1. **Scaling the guest list or the menu.** A smaller turkey, or a turkey breast instead of a whole bird, reduces waste when fewer people are attending.
segments.tr: 1. **Anpassung der Gästeliste oder des Menüs.** Ein kleinerer Truthahn oder eine Truthahnbrust statt eines ganzen Vogels reduziert den Abfall, wenn weniger Leute teilnehmen.

segments.src: 2. **Going potluck.** Assigning dishes to guests spreads both cost and effort.
segments.tr: 2. **Potluck-Essen.** Die Zuweisung von Gerichten an die Gäste verteilt sowohl die Kosten als auch den Aufwand.

segments.src: 3. **Choosing store brands.** For canned pumpkin, broth, flour and sugar, the quality difference is often small.
segments.tr: 3. **Wahl von Handelsmarken.** Bei Kürbiskonserven, Brühe, Mehl und Zucker ist der Qualitätsunterschied oft gering.

segments.src: 4. **Using loyalty programs and digital coupons.** Many grocers offer turkey discounts tied to a minimum purchase, so it helps to read the terms.
segments.tr: 4. **Nutzung von Treueprogrammen und digitalen Gutscheinen.** Viele Lebensmittelhändler bieten Truthahnrabatte an, die an einen Mindesteinkauf gebunden sind, daher lohnt es sich, die Bedingungen zu lesen.

segments.src: 5. **Buying early and freezing.** Picking up a frozen turkey during early promotions can lock in a price, as long as freezer space allows.
segments.tr: 5. **Früh kaufen und einfrieren.** Der Kauf eines gefrorenen Truthahns während früher Werbeaktionen kann einen Preis sichern, sofern der Platz im Gefrierschrank ausreicht.

segments.src: 6. **Baking from scratch.** A homemade pie typically costs less than a bakery pie, though the savings shrink if you must buy many specialty ingredients.
segments.tr: 6. **Selbst backen.** Ein hausgemachter Kuchen kostet normalerweise weniger als ein Kuchen aus der Bäckerei, obwohl die Ersparnisse schrumpfen, wenn Sie viele spezielle Zutaten kaufen müssen.

segments.src: 7. **Planning for leftovers.** Soups, sandwiches and casseroles stretch the meal over several days and reduce food waste.
segments.tr: 7. **Planung für Reste.** Suppen, Sandwiches und Aufläufe strecken die Mahlzeit über mehrere Tage und reduzieren Lebensmittelverschwendung.

segments.src: ## A Simple Way to Estimate Your Own Total
segments.tr: ## Eine einfache Möglichkeit, Ihre eigene Gesamtsumme zu schätzen

segments.tr: 5. Setzen Sie sich ein Limit, bevor Sie einkaufen gehen, und verfolgen Sie die Gesamtsumme während des Einkaufs.

segments.tr: - **Trứng, bơ và các sản phẩm từ sữa:** Những nguyên liệu này được dùng để làm bánh ngọt, nhân nhồi và món hầm. Đặc biệt trứng đã biến động trong những năm gần đây, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra đơn giá trước khi tích trữ.

segments.src: - **Baking staples:** Flour, sugar and shortening make up the pie crust. Store brands often match name brands at a lower price.
segments.tr: - **Nguyên liệu làm bánh:** Bột mì, đường và mỡ rút bánh tạo nên lớp vỏ bánh ngọt. Nhãn hiệu của cửa hàng thường có chất lượng tương đương nhãn hiệu nổi tiếng với mức giá thấp hơn.

segments.src: - **Spices:** Small jars add up, especially if you need several. Buying only what the recipes require, or using bulk sections, can trim the cost.
segments.tr: - **Gia vị:** Các hũ nhỏ cộng dồn lại có thể tốn kém, đặc biệt nếu bạn cần nhiều loại. Chỉ mua những gì công thức nấu ăn yêu cầu, hoặc sử dụng khu vực bán hàng theo kg/lô lớn, có thể giúp cắt giảm chi phí.

segments.src: - **Fresh produce:** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans and onions are seasonal and usually reasonable in November, though weather can change local pricing.
segments.tr: - **Rau củ tươi:** Khoai tây, khoai lang, đậu xanh và hành tây mang tính thời vụ và thường có giá hợp lý vào tháng 11, mặc dù thời tiết có thể làm thay đổi giá cả tại địa phương.

segments.src: - **Bread and stuffing mix:** Boxed mixes are convenient, but cubing day-old bread at home is often cheaper.
segments.tr: - **Bánh mì và hỗn hợp nhân nhồi:** Hỗn hợp đóng hộp rất tiện lợi, nhưng việc tự cắt bánh mì cũ thành khối vuông tại nhà thường rẻ hơn.

segments.src: ## How Families Are Trimming the Bill
segments.tr: ## Các Gia Đình Đang Cắt Giảm Hóa Đơn Như Thế Nào

segments.src: Shoppers have become practiced at holiday budgeting.
segments.tr: Người mua sắm đã trở nên thành thạo trong việc lập ngân sách cho ngày lễ.

segments.src: Common strategies include:
segments.tr: Các chiến lược phổ biến bao gồm:

segments.src: 1. **Scaling the guest list or the menu.** A smaller turkey, or a turkey breast instead of a whole bird, reduces waste when fewer people are attending.
segments.tr: 1. **Thu hẹp danh sách khách mời hoặc thực đơn.** Một con gà tây nhỏ hơn, hoặc chỉ dùng ức gà tây thay vì cả con, sẽ giúp giảm lãng phí khi có ít người tham dự hơn.

segments.src: 2. **Going potluck.** Assigning dishes to guests spreads both cost and effort.
segments.tr: 2. **Tổ chức tiệc góp món (potluck).** Phân công các món ăn cho khách mời sẽ giúp chia sẻ cả chi phí lẫn công sức chuẩn bị.

segments.src: 3. **Choosing store brands.** For canned pumpkin, broth, flour and sugar, the quality difference is often small.
segments.tr: 3. **Chọn nhãn hiệu của cửa hàng.** Đối với bí ngô đóng hộp, nước dùng, bột mì và đường, sự khác biệt về chất lượng thường không đáng kể.

segments.src: 4. **Using loyalty programs and digital coupons.** Many grocers offer turkey discounts tied to a minimum purchase, so it helps to read the terms.
segments.tr: 4. **Sử dụng chương trình khách hàng thân thiết và phiếu giảm giá kỹ thuật số.** Nhiều cửa hàng tạp hóa cung cấp các ưu đãi giảm giá gà tây đi kèm với mức mua sắm tối thiểu, vì vậy việc đọc kỹ các điều khoản là rất hữu ích.

segments.src: 5. **Buying early and freezing.** Picking up a frozen turkey during early promotions can lock in a price, as long as freezer space allows.
segments.tr: 5. **Mua sắm sớm và trữ đông.** Mua một con gà tây đông lạnh trong các đợt khuyến mãi sớm có thể chốt được mức giá tốt, miễn là không gian tủ đông cho phép.

segments.src: 6. **Baking from scratch.** A homemade pie typically costs less than a bakery pie, though the savings shrink if you must buy many specialty ingredients.
segments.tr: 6. **Tự nướng bánh tại nhà.** Một chiếc bánh tự làm thường có chi phí thấp hơn bánh mua ở tiệm, mặc dù khoản tiết kiệm này sẽ giảm đi nếu bạn phải mua nhiều nguyên liệu đặc sản.

segments.src: 7. **Planning for leftovers.** Soups, sandwiches and casseroles stretch the meal over several days and reduce food waste.
segments.tr: 7. **Lên kế hoạch cho đồ ăn thừa.** Súp, bánh mì kẹp và món hầm giúp kéo dài bữa ăn trong nhiều ngày và giảm thiểu lãng phí thực phẩm.

segments.src: ## A Simple Way to Estimate Your Own Total
segments.tr: ## Cách Đơn Giản Để Ước Tính Tổng Chi Phí Của Riêng Bạn

segments.src: Rather than relying on a headline number, build your own estimate:
segments.tr: Thay vì dựa vào một con số tiêu đề chung chung, hãy tự xây dựng bảng ước tính của riêng bạn:

segments.src: 1. Write down the dishes you plan to serve.
segments.tr: 1. Ghi lại các món ăn bạn dự định dọn lên bàn.

segments.src: 2. List the ingredients, then check what is already in your pantry.
segments.tr: 2. Liệt kê các nguyên liệu, sau đó kiểm tra xem những gì đã có sẵn trong tủ thức ăn của bạn.

segments.src: 3. Compare prices at two or three stores, using unit prices rather than sticker prices.
segments.tr: 3. So sánh giá tại hai hoặc ba cửa hàng, sử dụng đơn giá thay vì giá niêm yết trên bao bì.

segments.src: 4. Add a modest buffer, around ten percent, for items that run out or change in price.
segments.tr: 4. Thêm một khoản dự phòng vừa phải, khoảng mười phần trăm, cho các mặt hàng bị hết hoặc thay đổi giá.

segments.src: 5. Set a ceiling before you shop and track the total as you go.
segments.tr: 5. Đặt ra giới hạn chi tiêu trước khi đi mua sắm và theo dõi tổng số tiền trong suốt quá trình mua.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm Mấu Chốt

segments.src: The cost of Thanksgiving dinner in 2026 will depend less on any single factor than on where and how you shop.
segments.tr: Chi phí cho bữa tối Lễ Tạ Ơn vào năm 2026 sẽ ít phụ thuộc vào bất kỳ yếu tố đơn lẻ nào mà phụ thuộc vào việc bạn mua sắm ở đâu và như thế nào.

segments.src: Inflation, trade policy and poultry supply all play a role, but flexible planning, store promotions and a few smart substitutions can keep the meal affordable without losing what makes the day matter: the company around the table.
segments.tr: Lạm phát, chính sách thương mại và nguồn cung gia cầm đều đóng vai trò nhất định, nhưng kế hoạch linh hoạt, các chương trình khuyến mãi của cửa hàng và một vài sự thay thế thông minh có thể giúp bữa ăn có giá cả phải chăng mà vẫn giữ được ý nghĩa quan trọng nhất của ngày lễ: sự quây quần bên bàn ăn.
